# Alejandra Osorio

> Senior Product Designer, 8+ years across B2B SaaS, AI and data products, e-commerce and
> digital media. Based in Colombia, open to relocation and to remote roles in US and European
> time zones. Previously Twilio, Mercado Libre, Zubale, Benchmark Email, Merqueo, El Tiempo.

Industry-agnostic by method rather than by accident: frame the problem, find the real
constraint, choose the trade-off, ship it, measure it. Works close to the decision and close
to the code, including building and shipping in code with AI-assisted workflows.

Contact: https://alejandrao72-hue.github.io/#contact

## Case studies

- [Customer Intelligence Strategy, Twilio, 2024-2026](https://alejandrao72-hue.github.io/project-twilio-strategy.html):
  Co-created the observability journey the suite was built around and extended it during One
  Twilio, the migration onto a single platform. Six products mapped to one troubleshooting
  path. 35K+ accounts every quarter on Messaging Insights. Average troubleshooting time
  down 30 minutes. Created a chart pattern adopted across Twilio's design organization.
- [Messaging Insights and Intelligent Alerts, Twilio, 2024-2026](https://alejandrao72-hue.github.io/project-twilio-insights.html):
  Interaction design and data visualization for anomaly detection and investigation. Six
  dashboards unified on one interaction model. A core filtering task cut from six steps to two.
- [Gig Worker Onboarding Revamp, Zubale, 2021-2023](https://alejandrao72-hue.github.io/project-zubale-onboarding.html):
  Replaced onboarding spread across WhatsApp, chatbots, web and SMS with one app flow.
  Conversion to first task from 5.13% to 12.75%. Time to convert from 13.1 days to 3.7.
  Gated the signup reward behind two completed tasks after testing showed reward-only signups.
  Configuration tool serving 100+ clients without engineering.
- [Live Commerce, Mercado Libre, 2021](https://alejandrao72-hue.github.io/project-meli-video.html):
  Live video shopping taken from zero to pilot. Interaction rules for stream, product shelf,
  chat and checkout on one screen, scoped into three MVP versions, two dev-ready.
- [Order Status Tracker, Merqueo, 2020](https://alejandrao72-hue.github.io/project-merqueo-tracker.html):
  Order tracking redesigned during the 2020 demand spike, when order status and payment
  questions were 16% of all support tickets. Seven-state tracker, live delivery map, inline
  alerts. Copy comprehension validated with a 5-second test across 17 users.
